title: Dust Devil Tracks on Bright Dunes

meta.description: This image features dark dust devil tracks on bright dunes that have an odd distribution. The dunes look wind eroded: striations or layering? A false color contrast between dunes and dust devil tracks may provide information to understand dune formation, shape, and dust devil initiation. This footprint is in Galle Crater. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
